# Ambivert Technologies

> Ambivert Technologies Private Limited is an electronics company in Pune, India. It offers PCB prototyping, component sourcing and assembly services for hardware startups, and makes the Autoemx PLC.

## Services
- PCB prototyping: schematic and PCB layout, feasibility studies, proof-of-concept builds, rapid prototyping in-house.
- Component sourcing: components supplier LCSC, inventory planning, vendor management.
- Assembly: SMT assembly lines, quality checks, final assembly. Manufacturing partner: JLCPCB.
- IIoT integration.

## Products
- Autoemx PLC: programmable logic controller with a 2.8 inch capacitive touch HMI, on-device ladder editor, OpenPLC (IEC 61131-3) support, 8 digital inputs, 6 relay outputs, I2C, SD and USB expansion, over-the-air updates, DIN rail mounting. Starting price: INR 16,999.
- ESP32-S3 development kit with built-in LiPo battery.

## Brands
- CktHub (https://ckthub.com): standalone hardware that replaces subscription software.
- Ntagz (https://ntagz.com): NFC and RFID hardware for businesses.
- Tapinhere (https://tapinhere.com): digital profiles shared by NFC tap or QR code.
- EtherX: PROFINET connectors and other industrial connectors.
